description:
SGP is seeking organized, detail-oriented, and deadline-driven Proposal Coordinators to keep federal proposal efforts on track. You will manage proposal logistics, documentation, and coordination activities, allowing proposal managers and writers to focus on developing compelling, compliant content.

You'll bring experience working successfully as a 1099 consultant and be comfortable supporting multiple clients, each with distinct templates, repositories, review processes, and submission requirements. You'll also have experience collaborating with capture managers, proposal managers, writers, editors, graphic designers, and pricing and contracts professionals to keep contributors aligned and deliverables on schedule.

Workplace Type: Remote.

Compensation: 1099 Consultant. $95 -$115 per hour.

Why Join the SGP Capture & Proposals Team

As an SGP consultant, you'll enjoy the independence and flexibility of 1099 work while benefiting from the resources, collaboration, and professional support of an experienced capture and proposals team.

  • Select consultant network: Join a network of experienced capture and proposal professionals who bring diverse expertise and collaborate to support client needs across a variety of engagements.

  • The right fit, by design: We strive to align each consultant with client engagements that complement their professional expertise, career interests, and working styles, creating opportunities for meaningful contributions and successful collaboration.

  • Referral bonuses: Earn referral incentives for introducing prospective clients and qualified consultants to the SGP network, subject to program eligibility requirements.

  • Resources that raise the bar: Access optional professional development opportunities, established templates, industry best practices, and support from experienced professionals to strengthen the quality and efficiency of your work.

  • Flexibility and choice: Enjoy the flexibility of remote consulting and the opportunity to accept engagements that align with your availability, expertise, and professional interests.

  • Modern, AI-enabled workflows: Collaborate with a team that combines extensive federal contracting expertise with modern technologies and evolving AI-assisted tools and processes to support efficient, high-quality proposal development.

  • Breadth of experience: Gain exposure to a variety of federal agencies, contract vehicles, and clients, ranging from emerging small businesses to established government contractors.

Responsibilities

  • Establish and maintain proposal repositories, templates, and folder structures.

  • Track assignments, schedules, and deliverables; provide reminders and status updates.

  • Maintain compliance matrices and solicitation trackers, including amendments and Questions and Answers (Q&A).

  • Coordinate color team review logistics and consolidate reviewer feedback.

  • Format, edit, and assemble proposal volumes in accordance with solicitation requirements, including page limits, fonts, margins, and file-naming conventions.

  • Manage final production activities and maintain electronic submission checklists.

  • Collect and organize resumes, past performance write-ups, and boilerplate content.

Required qualifications

  • At least three years of experience in federal proposal coordination or proposal support.

  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Word, including styles, templates, cross-references, tables of contents, and strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel.

  • Experience with SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, and Adobe Acrobat.

  • Exceptional attention to detail and the ability to remain composed under tight deadlines.

Preferred qualifications

  • APMP Foundation-level certification.

  • Experience with federal electronic submission portals, including PIEE, GSA eBuy, and agency-specific platforms.

  • Familiarity with proposal management platforms and AI-assisted development tools.
